headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving profit gains for several firms.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest single‑digit to over 50% YoY. AI‑related revenue contributed to profit acceleration at Infosys, HCLTech, TCS and LTM. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, while Wipro saw a slight profit decline.

themes.title: AI‑enabled services
themes.detail: AI revenue grew sharply, boosting profits at Infosys (29% YoY), HCLTech ($219 m) and TCS ($3.1 bn).

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY growth, while Infosys grew only 1.5% YoY.
